limits: Only immutable install-v4/v5/v6 source snapshots are linked to these runs; no current evolving production headers or v7/v8 resource results are included.
All runs have independent init submit=false. Existing native mesh/API draws and visibility extension remained active; comparison success is not independent transport/export.
665 is comparisons per measured Alfea frame, not all objects or a production completion percentage; unique (support,Model) candidates and actual repeated draws have different denominators.
All sampled owner kinds are exact Static(0); RenderNode Domino was rejected by installed v6 empty-listener guard. Listener fix belongs to later source, not these DLLs.
The v4 state25 alpha cause is inferred retrospectively from v5 exact diagnostics plus A/B/A; v4 itself did not log detailed device differences.
Optional inverse error fields absent in older records must not be reported as measured zero; presence counts are supplied.
Bridge restoration JSON records completion; current shared installation config is not reread while root works on its next stage.
Screenshots are existence/hash evidence only unless explicitly marked root-reviewed. The absent v4 loaded capture is not an artifact.
This checkpoint does not fix light placement, camera visibility or independent geometry; overall45 percent is a planning estimate.
